C6_metric_M3_gravity_closure.note: gravity-only momentum algebra closes on the 3x3 lattice at first order in gamma (exact)

M1_gamma_order.method: residual(rho) with gamma -> eps*gamma; O(eps) coefficient extracted at eps=0
M1_gamma_order.verdict: exact at order gamma^1 (first order in the metric perturbation); residual O(gamma^2) = truncation defect of Gamma^{(1)} + O(Delta^2) lattice Leibniz defect

M2_gamma_order.verdict: exact at order gamma^0; O(gamma) residual = moment-map defect of the Gamma^{(1)}-truncated generator (the exact-connection generator satisfies {pi,H}=L_xi pi up to the O(Delta^2) lattice Leibniz defect; the defect is a truncation diagnostic, not a counterexample to the claim)

M3_flat_limit.verdict: flat-limit residual nonzero on the 3x3 lattice = pure lattice defect of the discrete product rule inside the {h_li, pi}-contraction terms of {H(xi),H(eta)} (no Gamma-truncation remains at gamma=0); it vanishes for smooth periodic fields (numeric probe: |residual| < 1e-16 at matching profiles) and in the continuum limit, where {H(xi),H(eta)} = H([xi,eta]) holds by the exact IBP identity (derivation.md); full-residual O(gamma) Gamma^(1)-truncation part recorded above

C8a_C4_scaling_probe.verdict: closure defect {G(xi),G(eta)} - G([xi,eta]) scales as O(step^2) -> vanishes in the continuum limit; the lattice momentum algebra closes in the continuum limit by exact IBP (derivation.md)

_verdict.statement: the extended spatial diffeomorphism generator H_i = -2 D_j pi^j_i + sum pi_A D_i phi_A + pi_U D_i U + pi_Z D_i Z + int dr(pi_W D_i W + pi_L D_i L) + pi_lambda0 D_i lambda0 acts by Lie derivatives on every field of the CA5-GNC-R phase space (C1: 64/64 exact), reduces exactly to the physical momentum constraint (C2) and is first-class w.r.t. the auxiliary primary constraints (C3). The negative control fires exactly as predicted (C5). Metric-sector Lie bracket identities verified at the stated orders: M1 exact at order gamma^1, M2 and the momentum-algebra closure exact at order gamma^0 (flat) with quantified O(gamma) truncation defects of the Gamma^(1) generator; the lattice closure defects converge quadratically to zero (C8a)
_verdict.not_promoted: not promoted to complete gravity closure; AS151 dependency (primary constraints) is a sibling in flight - see ancestry/limitations
